summary: RRE Ventures Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed Form 8-K on April 29, 2026 to announce entry into an Underwriting Agreement for its initial public offering (IPO) of 25 million units at $10.00 per unit, with an over-allotment option for an additional 3.75 million units. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-third of one redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. Underwriters purchase price is $9.40 per firm unit and $9.50 per additional unit, with a deferred discount. This is a standard SPAC IPO registration. No deal terms or premiums apply here. Watch for completion of IPO and subsequent target acquisition.
